command:
set -eu
mkdir -p evidence
python3 -m venv .proof-venv
.proof-venv/bin/python -m pip install 'pytest==9.0.2' 'pytest-timeout>=2.4' 'setuptools==80.9.0' 'wheel==0.46.3' build pyyaml jsonschema filelock python-dotenv uv
.proof-venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps ./runtime ./agent
export PATH="$PWD/.proof-venv/bin:$PATH"
unset XDG_CONFIG_HOME
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/agent:$PWD/runtime:$PWD/runtime/packages/python"
export ASTRID_RUNTIME_CHECKOUT="$PWD/runtime" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
cd agent
set +e
../.proof-venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_installer_legacy_live_update.py tests/test_installer_update_job.py tests/test_verify_installed.py tests/test_installer_predecessor_wheel.py tests/test_installer_wheel.py tests/test_installer_acl.py tests/test_installer_current.py > ../evidence/collection.log 2>&1
collection=$?
python3 -c 'import re,sys; s=open("../evidence/collection.log").read(); m=re.search(r"(\d+)(?:/\d+)? tests? collected", s); sys.exit(0 if m and int(m.group(1)) > 0 else 1)'
nonzero_collection=$?
../.proof-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --timeout=90 tests/test_installer_legacy_live_update.py tests/test_installer_update_job.py tests/test_verify_installed.py tests/test_installer_predecessor_wheel.py tests/test_installer_wheel.py tests/test_installer_acl.py tests/test_installer_current.py > ../evidence/focused.log 2>&1
focused=$?
printf 'collection=%s\nnonzero_collection=%s\nfocused=%s\n' "$collection" "$nonzero_collection" "$focused" > ../evidence/inner-exit-codes.txt
cat ../evidence/inner-exit-codes.txt
tail -n 80 ../evidence/focused.log
if [ "$collection" -ne 0 ] || [ "$nonzero_collection" -ne 0 ] || [ "$focused" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
